title: Monthly Cash and Bank Reconciliation Summary
brief: A monthly bank reconciliation summary for a commercial client drafted from their general ledger and statement balances.

slip.document:
# Monthly Cash and Bank Reconciliation Summary

For the period ending 04/30/2026, the First Meridian Bank statement for Crestview Logistics LLC shows an ending balance of $84,200. Deposits in transit of $6,300 were added and outstanding checks totaling $12,500 were deducted, giving an adjusted bank balance of $80,150. On the book side, the unadjusted general ledger cash balance of $78,150 was reduced by a $150 bank service fee, for an adjusted book balance of $78,000. The two adjusted balances agree and no further reconciling items are open.

errors.quote: giving an adjusted bank balance of $80,150
errors.explanation: $84,200 plus $6,300 in transit minus $12,500 in outstanding checks is $78,000, not $80,150. The summary then claims the two sides agree when they are $2,150 apart.
errors.fix: giving an adjusted bank balance of $78,000
